text:
maya: Quick plan - partner co-marketing with CloudLane: 3-week microblog series + gated technical webinar. Goal: 200 MQLs, 40 demo requests, route partner-ready leads to CloudLane. Thoughts? :sparkles:

liam: sounds good. we need an attribution rule up front. propose partner owner tag in SFDC + 70/30 revenue credit split.

maya: routing idea: all form leads -> SFDC with partner=CloudLane, push to redwood_sdr + cloudlane_sales queues. redwood does first-touch qual, then handoff if deep integration needed.

sara: blog lineup: 4 short posts - 1) mini-case with metrics, 2) integration how-to, 3) benchmark highlight (latency/cost), 4) ops playbook for platform teams. i'll draft 2 headline variants each.

oscar: landing form fields: name, company, email, role, partner_optin checkbox. map to HubSpot -> SFDC: lead_source=cloudlane_microseries, partner_optin=true.

jess: webinar format: 15m product, 15m partner case, 10m demo, 20m q/a. who hosts demo env? cloudlane volunteered to host.

paul: confirmed partner speaker and demo env. i'll get speaker names and slides by eod thursday. rehearsal friday 11am PT.

nate: recommend simple A/B headline test on landing page (variant=A / variant=B) to measure CTR. include variant param in form.

liam: add hidden form field partner_campaign_id to preserve attribution if UTMs are stripped. ops-bot can we create a task?

ops-bot: Task KL-8122 created: add hidden partner_campaign_id to CloudLane landing form and map to SFDC.custom_partner_campaign. Due in 3 days. https://tasks.internal/KL-8122 :white_check_mark:

maya: timeline: week1=copy + landing page live, week2=email invites + rehearsal, week3=webinar + nurture. next steps: sara (copy), paul (partner confirm), ops (form mapping), jess (logistics). sync on wed standup. :rocket:
